cytotropic antibody.example: Cytophilic antibodies are responsible for the allergic immunological response of the organism.

czar.definition: a male monarch or emperor (especially of Russia prior to 1917)

czardas.definition: a piece of music composed for the Hungarian Csárdás dance.
czardas.example: The Csárdás is characterized by a variation in tempo: it starts out slowly (lassú) and ends in a very fast tempo (friss, literally ‘fresh’).

czardas.definition: a piece of music in the rhythm of the Hungarian Csárdás dance.
czardas.example: Classical composers who have used csárdás themes in their works include Emmerich Kálmán, Franz Liszt, Johannes Brahms, Léo Delibes, Johann Strauss, Pablo de Sarasate, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky and others.

czarina.definition: the wife or widow of a czar

czarist.definition: of or relating to or characteristic of a czar

czaristic.definition: of or relating to or characteristic of a czar

czaritza.definition: the wife or widow of a czar

czech.definition: of or relating to Czechoslovakia or its people or their language
a native of inhabitant of the Czech Republic
a native or inhabitant of the former republic of Czechoslovakia

czechness.definition: The quality or characteristic of being Czech.
czechness.example: There's more Czechness in Brno than in Prague, says American academic now living in the Czech Republic.

czechoslovak.definition: a native or inhabitant of the former republic of Czechoslovakia

czechoslovakian.definition: of or relating to Czechoslovakia or its people or their language
a native or inhabitant of the former republic of Czechoslovakia

czworniak.definition: a Polish mead, made using three units of water for each unit of honey.
